description:
Dirtbag Bar is a whole food energy solution to ultra-processed gunk bars.  We have No Ultra-Processed Gunk. No Added Sugars. Vegan and Gluten Free.

Made with nutrient-dense, certified organic ingredients, delivering sustained energy for your everyday endurance. Fueling trail running, gravel cycling, marathons, and whatever you do. It is your complete and clean energy snack bar. 


What makes us different

Dirtbag Bar is a chef made, organic, whole food alternative to ultra-processed energy bars.

No ultra-processed gunk, no added sugars, no liquid syrups, no seed oils, no protein concentrates, no additives.

Packed With Whole Food Benefits for Better Energy

    •    Dates for natural sugars with no crashes

    •    Whole grain oats for slow-release complex carbs

    •    Nuts and seeds for quality plant-based protein

    •    100% dark chocolate for improved energy production and muscle function

    •    Fast absorbing and easy to digest

Sustained Energy from Balanced Macros. This balance helps keep your energy steady, gut comfy, and body happy without the spike and crash that ultra-processed fuel gives you.

How You Can Earn

You earn 15% commission on total sales made through your tracked affiliate link. Share Dirtbag Bar with your audience, get paid when they buy.

Fueling something bigger than us

Every bar helps take care of people and the places we run, ride, and roam. A portion of all sales goes to 1% for Mental Health and 1% for the Planet.

Ideas on How to best Promote Us

Keep it real and in-the-wild: runs, rides, hikes, climbs, long days outside. Try to avoid holding the bar up in a location and call it done.

Talk about why you like it, how you feel, tell the world your POV about it.

Use the “no” ultra-processed ingredients list as your hook: no liquid syrups, no seed oils, no protein concentrates, no additives.

Show the “Good Stuff Inside” ingredient list in your content: sweet dates, whole grain oats, nuts and seeds, and 100% dark chocolate. Tell people about the benefits of these ingredients.
